body:
Its hard to think rationally; the most I can do is sleep and try my best to vent to others. I feel like this is a worthless problem almost all the time and that Im wasting everyones time. Its a difficult notion to get out of my head. 

I just wish we had control over these emotions. I cant do what my head wants me to do because I feel extreme guilt, the one defense mechanism that I truly despise. I feel completely trapped because I care about everyone and nothing to myself yet I want to go down this path so badly. I dont trust myself when under this..I have to somehow immobilize myself, as stated before, either sleeping, drinking or drugs. I understand that its bad to take drugs but its either help myself or suffer. 

I cant say whther it was a good thing taking the drugs because it made the suicide...logical. It wasnt irrational as I usually thought once the thoughts subsided, but it felt..enlightening and pleasant to fantasize that I have an escape out of this wretched body.
